English translation of (probably) a Greek translation of an oral tradition of an Aramaic-speaking people. Aside from the difficulty translating concepts from one language to another, it was (again, probably) written down a couple of thousand years after its origin. Originally it could have meant something like "Forgive us for pissing people off and we'll forgive people who piss us off."

Same sort of problem with the Iliad and the Odyssey, the first written version of stories that previously had been passed along verbally for a millennium or so.
